title: Thai Braised Oxtail Curry
description: A flavorful and tender Thai-inspired oxtail curry made with zesty and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the oxtail until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the oxtail from the pot and set aside.
Add the nam prik paste to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the brown sugar, fish sauce, and soy sauce to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Return the oxtail to the pot and add the kaffir lime leaves and Thai basil leaves.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the oxtail for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shreds with a fork.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the oxtail hot, garnished with additional Thai basil leaves if desired.
